title: cert.rs: pkix-chain index in map_pkix_error may not align with build_chain order
description: map_pkix_error() uses PE::SignatureInvalid { index } and PE::NotCA { index } with subject_at(index), where index is into the chain slice passed to pkix_chain::verify_chain_default(). However, the chain slice comes from build_chain() which is leaf-first. pkix-chain may or may not use the same ordering. If pkix-chain indexes from the trust-anchor end (root-first), index 0 means the root, but subject_at(0) returns the leaf cert subject. This causes misleading error messages - wrong certificate subject is shown. The code works correctly for the validation itself; only the error attribution is wrong.
notes: INVESTIGATED: pkix-chain docs confirm 'chain[0] is the subject cert' (leaf-first). The chain passed to verify_chain_default comes from build_chain() which is also leaf-first. So index 0 in pkix error = chain[0] = signer_cert. Indices align. NOT a bug. Downgrading to opinion/false-alarm.
